messages:
elaine (CEO): @here Quick reminder — leadership 'Listen + Act' all-hands this Friday 4/8 @ 10:00am PT. Short agenda below, recording will be posted. Please drop any questions in this thread or use the form by Thursday 6pm PT. :wave:

samir (CTO): I’ll cover infra scaling plans, Dedicated capacity roadmap, and a quick note on latency SLOs. 5–7 mins.

june (Product): I’ll do a customer demo (3 mins) + product priorities for the quarter — would love 2 customer quotes to highlight.

maria (People Ops): Q&A collection form: https://forms.redwood.example/listen-act — pls submit no more than 3 short questions. We’ll prioritize high-signal ones. Also reminder: RSVP if you haven’t.

dennis (Eng): can we slot 3 mins for the recent incident summary? ops postmortem will be one slide + action items.

ops-bot: Recording will be available after the meeting in #all-hands-recordings and in Drive: https://drive.redwood.example/allhands/2026-04-08. :file_folder:

katie (Recruiting): quick hiring update (hiring velocity, open IC roles) — 2 slides. Happy to take a followup sync for hiring Qs.

luis (Sales): will leadership call out the Dedicated public launch date? need clarity to prep customer comms.

elaine (CEO): Agenda (10:00–11:00am PT): 1) Company pulse + exec updates (elaine) 2) Tech & infra priorities (samir) 3) Product demo + GTM notes (june + luis) 4) Dedicated launch summary + customer comms (samir/luis) 5) Incident recap + actions (dennis) 6) Hiring snapshot (katie) 7) Live AMA (10–15 mins) + close.

june (Product): AMA note — pls flag any sensitive product questions in the form so we can prep answers.

maria (People Ops): Please try to keep on-topic Qs short; we’ll triage in real time. If we don’t get to your Q, we’ll follow up in thread or via a doc.

dennis (Eng): TL;DR for incident slide: brief timeline, root cause (routing bug), customer impact, actions (patch + improved circuit-breaker). Full postmortem ready in #incidents later today.

elaine (CEO): Action items before Thursday 6pm PT: - Submit form questions - Add any must-cover slides (share in this thread) - RSVP. We’ll publish the all-hands notes doc after the meeting with explicit next steps.

luis (Sales): For comms sync — can someone share the target launch window as soon as execs confirm? I’ll prep a draft customer email. :email:

katie (Recruiting): Small ask — if you have candidate referrals, drop to me before Friday; will mention open roles during hiring slide.

elaine (CEO): Recording link + notes will be posted here after the meeting. Looking forward to a short, focused session — bring a question or two. :sparkles:
